newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aeon Credit shares hit record high in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Aeon Credit shares hit record high in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares in Aeon Credit Service Co Ltd rose to their highest level ever on Friday morning, brokers said.
The company's shares were up 160 yen at 7,560 yen at midday, surpassing the previous intra-day high of 7,450 yen marked on January 6. Turnover was 53,700 shares.
Buying was ignited by expectations that the consumer credit firm would benefit from a possible easing in government restrictions on non-banks' fund-raising, brokers said.
The firm listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange last month.
Aeon Credit is 48.6 percent owned by Japan's leading supermarket operator Jusco Co Ltd.
